title: Freehold Hilltop Land in Pecatu
description: Twelve ares of elevated freehold land on the Pecatu plateau with a glimpse of the Indian Ocean from ground level and open views from a second storey. Wide 6-metre road frontage makes construction logistics straightforward. Tourism zoning confirmed; PDAM water and three-phase electricity available at the road.
investmentNote: The Bukit is transitioning from raw land to a mature resort district — Pecatu freehold at this price per are is a hold-and-develop play. Suitable for a multi-villa estate or a branded-residence partnership, with freehold title giving maximum exit flexibility.
